int head[6010], prev_edge[6010], dist[6010], in_queue[6010];
queue<int> q;
struct Edge { int dest, capacity, weight, next; } edges[2000010];

int encode(int time, int vertex) { return time * n + vertex; }

void insert_edge(int src, int dst, int cap, int cost) {
    edges[edge_count] = {dst, cap, cost, head[src]};
    head[src] = edge_count++;
    edges[edge_count] = {src, 0, -cost, head[dst]};
    head[dst] = edge_count++;
}

bool find_shortest_path(int source, int sink) {
    fill(dist, dist + MAX_NODES, INF);
    q.push(source);
    dist[source] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int cur = q.front(); q.pop();
        in_queue[cur] = 0;
        for (int idx = head[cur]; ~idx; idx = edges[idx].next) {
            int v = edges[idx].dest;
            if (edges[idx].capacity && dist[v] > dist[cur] + edges[idx].weight) {
                dist[v] = dist[cur] + edges[idx].weight;
                prev_edge[v] = idx;
                if (!in_queue[v]) {
                    q.push(v);
                    in_queue[v] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[sink] < 1000000000;
}

void augment_path(int source, int sink) {
    for (int node = sink; node != source; node = edges[prev_edge[node] ^ 1].dest) {
        edges[prev_edge[node]].capacity--;
        edges[prev_edge[node] ^ 1].capacity++;
    }
    total_cost += dist[sink];
}

    memset(head, -1, sizeof(head));
    scanf("%d %d %d %d %d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);

        insert_edge(source, encode(0, arrival_times[i]), 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d %d", &from_node[i], &to_node[i]);
    }
    for (int t = 0; t <= 100; t++) {
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            insert_edge(encode(t, i), encode(t + 1, i), k, c);
        }
        insert_edge(encode(t, 1), sink, k, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {

                insert_edge(encode(t, from_node[i]), encode(t + 1, to_node[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                insert_edge(encode(t, to_node[i]), encode(t + 1, from_node[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
